component.name: 動畫字卡
component.description: 在框的中央出現標題文字：彈出、打字機、逐字跳入或漸層，最多三行

component.name: 箭頭
component.description: 從框外某個方向畫出、飛入或彈入一支箭頭，尖端指向框的邊緣或角

component.name: Screen in a scene
component.description: The video plays on a screen in a 3D scene (desk, classroom board or studio); starts and ends full-frame so it cuts in seamlessly

component.name: Mascot
component.description: A little 3D character walks in, stops next to the target box and waves or points at it
